limitations: All metrics above are nominal PhysX core diagnostics, not full-clip averages or statistical success rates.
PD and solver changes are fixed-policy deployment sensitivity tests; they do not rule out retraining under those settings.
Both new PPO candidates use the same 12,288,000-transition from-scratch budget, one seed, historical DR and PD500/10.
Loaded USD-authored solver settings are not native backend solver-count readback; more iterations do not establish ground truth.
HF means frequencies strictly above10Hz with the declared detrend/Hann/Parseval normalization. Raw poses are not smoothed.
No weights, robot assets, original reference data or credentials are published by this summary.
